title: Extract DLQ, locks, approvals, and policy-eval handlers
description: Move remaining handler groups from gateway_handlers.go into domain files: (1) gateway_dlq.go: handleListDLQ, handleListDLQPage, handleDeleteDLQ, handleRetryDLQ. (2) gateway_locks.go: handleGetLock, handleAcquireLock, handleReleaseLock, handleRenewLock. (3) gateway_approvals.go: handleApproveStep, handleCancelRun, handleListApprovals, handleApproveJob, handleRejectJob. (4) gateway_policy_eval.go: handlePolicyEvaluate, handlePolicySimulate, handlePolicyExplain, handlePolicySnapshots, handlePolicyCheck (the evaluation/simulation delegation to safety kernel — NOT the bundle CRUD which stays in policy_bundles.go). Include private types only used by each group. Keep package gateway.
